art_direction: 倒置的深绿雨伞长出一小束根，伞内藏着淡紫云团，象牙底呈现轻盈标志。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create an upside-down forest-green umbrella that holds one pale lavender cloud instead of rain. A few short roots emerge from the tip below, suggesting the object is beginning to grow. The handle is a thin curved charcoal line rising beside the cloud. Keep the umbrella panels broad and flat, using just one darker section to describe their fold. Center the entire object on an ivory square with ample negative space. The cloud should remain abstract and compact, without a face or tiny weather symbols. Limit the roots to three graceful strands. The silhouette must be legible as both an umbrella and a small imaginary plant, without adding scenery.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
